title: Preparing for the Hunt
description: Kara Vex, a professional hunter known as 'Stalker,' has agreed to help you hunt the wyrm dragon. She's hunted wyrm dragons before and knows their weaknesses. But first, you need the right equipment and a solid plan. Wyrm dragons are smart, fast, and deadly. Going in unprepared is suicide.
shortDescription: Prepare for the wyrm dragon hunt with expert hunter Kara Vex

objectives.description: Meet with Kara 'Stalker' Vex to discuss the hunt
Gather hunting equipment (heavy weapons, explosives, medpacs)
Plan the attack strategy with Kara
Recruit Kara as a companion for the hunt (optional)
